resources.string: You usually went to bed around %1$s. On average your bedtime was %2$s away from that. You usually woke around %3$s, varying by about %4$s.
The CDC recommends going to bed and getting up at the same time every day. It doesn\'t give a number for how close is close enough, so this app describes your schedule rather than grading it.

The CDC recommends 7 or more hours of sleep for adults aged 18–60, 7–9 hours for ages 61–64, and 7–8 hours for 65 and over. The NHLBI recommends 7–9 hours for adults. This app checks against at least 7 hours, which all of these share.

These are general guidelines for adults, not a medical assessment. Sleep needs vary. This app doesn\'t measure sleep stages or detect sleep disorders. If you\'re concerned about your sleep, talk to a doctor. Recommended amounts are higher for people under 18.
